dissolveObjects_help: Off: grouped values such as grid, pv or battery are stored as one JSON text. On: they are split into single data points (e.g. status.Grid.power) – handy for VIS, charts and triggers, but creates more data points.
host_error: Please enter a host or IP address without http:// and without a path
host_help: IP address or host name of your evcc installation, without http://
polltime_help: How often evcc is read. Shorter = more up to date values, but more load.
port_help: Port of the evcc web interface (default 7070)
weatherForecast_help: Writes the forecast time series of evcc to status.Forecast. Only needed if you evaluate the forecasts yourself in ioBroker.
weatherForecast_warning: Note: creates about 1,800 data points that are updated on every poll.
